question: What happens to the Rudras when their office ends?
premises: The Rudras' office eventually comes to an end.
They move onward together with the host of Rudra's daughters.
They ascend from city to city above Rudra in successive stages.
inference: Even after completing their office, the Rudras continue an upward progression through higher realms.
plain_english: When their office ends, they go on together with the host of Rudra's daughters, ascending from city to city above Rudra in ever higher succession.
